pieces.Text: You deliver a DNA-twisting or material-altering chemical nanite compound into a creature's body, imparting vulnerability to one type of energy (your choice). If the creature is immune to that energy type, this inhibitor temporarily removes that immunity and gives the creature resistance 20 to that type of energy. If the creature has resistance to that energy type, this effect instead reduces its resistance by 10 (minimum 0). This biohack does not remove a creature's resistance or immunity to natural hazards or environments, only to damage from energy attacks, spells, and other abilities.
